# Portable extraction evidence

Local macOS: 9 scoped + 7 portable tests pass Debug/Release; clippy/fmt/HC pass.
Linux adds raw-name tests; Windows portable API runtime checks await hosted CI.
SpecPM has no errors; unresolved host platform dependencies remain draft warnings.
One-directory listing, errors/cancellation prefix and bytes conversion are extracted;
recursive traversal, worker/scan lifecycle, selected-tree race safety, cloud policy
and product status/nesting stay host-owned. No speed/memory claim.
Current maps add portable enumeration/sizing roles; previous scoped metadata evidence
is historical for that unchanged implementation, not proof of these new APIs.
